dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: Every orchestration step executed successfully with 100% schema validation pass rate across all reasoning spans. The rules context was loaded correctly in the initial step, and all downstream reasoning adhered strictly to governance constraints and predefined prompt schemas without errors.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The causal chain progressed cleanly from rules context loading through conversation-to-aw, architecture evolution mapping, alignment analysis, and final architecture intent generation. intermediate artifacts were validated successfully, evidencing consistent cause-effect progression across the architecture synthesis pipeline.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: The alignment-engine executed without faults and produced a validated alignment report, demonstrating systematic identification and surfacing of architectural tensions. The subsequent architecture intent generator successfully reconciled these tensions into concrete architectural decisions.
